'''Unfold Your Dreams''' is the ending theme for the 2013 Korean redubbing of ''[[M07|Pokémon: Destiny Deoxys]]''. It is performed by Kim Jieun. 

It uses the same music as the corresponding Japanese ending theme [[L·O·V·E·L·Y ~Dreaming LOVELY BOY~]]. The movie also features a version which features {{p|Pikachu}}, {{p|Plusle}}, and {{p|Minun}} singing along with the music.
